verdict.rationale: Auth0's own Actions are versioned, tenant-hosted Node.js functions that run automatically within login and identity flows, and log streaming exports tenant logs continuously in near real-time. Both are user-configured logic that runs without manual intervention, but they are tied to identity events rather than being general background automations. Missing for 10: scheduled or cron-style jobs, general-purpose background workflows independent of login events, agent-driven autonomous task execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
